## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the edge observed in the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE study (OOS exp/tr monotone increase: $36.34 → $59.02 → $66.13 for 0DTE→1DTE→2DTE) persists to 3DTE, meaning the OOS exp/tr for 3DTE will be ≥ $66.13. The edge is attributed to lower theta on entry premium rather than gap gambling, as held-overnight % remains near zero at the -8% stop.

## Mechanism

Same directional signal (vwap_continuation) and same strike (ITM-2) as the original study, but now including 3DTE options. Exit rules unchanged: -8% stop/+30% target. We will backfill OPRA data for 3DTE options (exactly 3 days to expiration) and compute OOS exp/tr using the same walk-forward windows as the original study. The analysis will reuse `backtest/autoresearch/multiday_dte_compare.py` with an extended DTE bucket.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (same as ITM-2 0DTE/1DTE/2DTE study; 3DTE premium higher → fewer contracts needed for same risk).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size and selection method identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE (vwap_continuation signal); overfit risk low as no parameters are optimized, only DTE variable extended.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will compute walk-forward held-out window post backfill).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending OPRA backfill).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: unknown until backtest (potential for lower exp/tr if edge decays beyond 2DTE).
   - Max drawdown: unknown (depends on equity curve shape).
   - Blow-up scenario: 3DTE options may have wider bid/ask spreads than 2DTE, increasing slippage risk; if real-fills show >20% diff from BS-sim, candidate invalidated.
6. **Concentration:** unknown until backtest (requires top-5 days P&L aggregation post backtest).
